entities.summary: Sergey Anatolievich Zverev is a Russian hairstylist, cosmetic artist, fashion designer and singer. Zverev has appeared on several television shows, including Full Fashion (Muz-TV) Star In the Cube, and Stars In Fashion (RU.TV).
